title: fix(cli): stage os skills writes and swap them in by rename, recording last (re-land)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

Fixes #35079

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:命令行用户运行「安装技能」或「更新技能」时,若中途写盘失败(磁盘满、无权限、被中断),原有技能和安装记录保持原样,下次直接再运行更新即可,不再需要加强制参数。
- 为什么做:这是技能安装可靠性修复的重新合入;上次合入后因车队门禁读不懂暂存目录而被撤回,门禁那一侧已按你「扫描只管仓内运行的代码」的裁决改好。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是安装或更新在失败时留下一个隐藏的暂存目录,它不会被当成技能读取,下次写入时自动删除;可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

This re-lands the staged swap of PR #35495 (merge commit `578d3b1d66`), byte for byte. PR #35616 reverted it because the dispatch-gates `mkdtempSync` completeness rule could not read the staging base. That base is computed from the caller's `dir`, and the scan reads one file at a time. PR #36368 (merged `fb6eb801b2c`) carries out ruling record 7075362923: an unresolved site in shipped package source is now reported, not failed. So the diff lands as written.

- `packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts`, `applySkillsWrite`: every new skill directory is written into one hidden staging directory inside the skills directory (`.objectstack-skills-staging-*`, from `mkdtempSync`, so it sits on the same filesystem). Each touched skill is renamed aside into it, and its staged copy is renamed into place. The record is written into the staging directory and renamed over the old one, after every swap. Any throw undoes the renames already done, newest first. The next write removes any leftover staging directories. They are hidden, so `status`, the plan and `inspectSkillsDir` never read them as skills.
- `packages/cli/test/skills-commands.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe` in the shared harness. It injects `ENOSPC` at three points (a staged file write, moving the second skill into place, the record rename) and has one leftover-staging case. The fault seam is a hoisted pass-through `vi.mock('node:fs')`. The test's own scratch base is `tmpdir()`, which the scan can read.
- `.changeset/35079-skills-write-staged-swap.md`: #35495's patch changeset for `@objectstack/cli`, unchanged.

Proof of identity with #35495: `git diff --cached` after `git cherry-pick -n 578d3b1d66` equals `git diff 578d3b1d66~1 578d3b1d66` (a `diff` of the two outputs printed nothing). Both target files on `origin/main` `ff601499008` are byte-equal to the merge's parent `eb1f85d7f4`: `git diff eb1f85d7f4 HEAD` on those two paths was empty before the pick. So nothing on main needed adapting.

Files to read first (risk order):
1. `packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts`, `applySkillsWrite`'s `try`/`catch` and `undoSwap`. This is the swap and its rollback.
2. `packages/cli/test/skills-commands.test.ts`, the `vi.mock('node:fs')` fault seam at the top of the file. It is a pass-through unless a test arms it.
3. `packages/cli/test/skills-commands.test.ts`, the describe `an interrupted write leaves the installed catalog usable`.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep "no mkdtempSync site in a test file"` should print one passing line. It reports `packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts:246` under "reported, not failed".

## Tests

All readings at head `009ca680a2f` (base `origin/main` `ff601499008`).

- `packages/cli/test/skills-commands.test.ts`, run under the verify lock after the `@objectstack/cli^...` closure build: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 34 passed (34)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. That is the 30 existing cases plus the 4 new interrupted-write pins.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`: exit 0 in the same locked run.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test`, both tiers: `fast 2264 case(s) · slow 315 case(s)`, `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2579 cases pass.`, exit 0. It includes the slow case this re-land was blocked on, which now passes.
- Declared narrowing: the full cli `unit` tier and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` did not get a lock turn before this PR opened. Two long batteries owned by other seats held the shared lock for more than an hour. Both are declared to CI (`Test Core`, `TypeScript Type Check`). The `integration` tier is declared to CI: the diff touches no integration-tier file and no spawn entry.

<details><summary>The live slow case, from the full self-test log</summary>

```text
  ✓ the sweep really read this tree (3154 directory-creating site(s) across 23442 tracked source(s))
  ✓ and it really found in-tree fixture roots (93), so the coverage case below judges something
  ✓ every in-tree directory this tree's sources create is covered by a tracked ignore rule, or is tracked itself
  ✓ no mkdtempSync site in a test file or repo tooling takes a base the scan cannot read — reported, not failed (shipped package source, base chosen at run time): packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts:246 (dir is not bound in this file)
dispatch-gates self-test tiers: fast 2264 case(s) in 576.2s · slow 315 case(s) in 1879.5s.
✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2579 cases pass.
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Gate-side unblock: the slow case's own logic also passed when called through the scan's exports at head `009ca680a2f` (`exposedScratchDirs({})` + `mkdtempCompleteness`): 3154 sites across 23442 tracked sources, 93 in-tree, exposed 0, unresolved 508, failing 0, reported 1 (`packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts:246 (dir is not bound in this file)`). No `scripts/pm/**` file is touched.
- Residual, unchanged from #35495: a hard kill (SIGKILL, power loss, an unhandled SIGINT) inside the rename-only swap window can still leave mixed state. The failure path the card names, a throw the process survives, is handled. The hard-kill window is tracked as #35502.
- Ablation not re-run: the source and test are byte-identical to #35495, whose red-before and ablation runs are on record in its os-dev-report (7008338749): 4 failed / 30 passed on the old source, 34 / 34 on the fix.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 64 derived, 61 run, 3 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun (head 009ca680a2f)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 64 families. Each one ran with its exit code captured before any pipe. Then `--ran` reconciled them: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED (3 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).`
- 61 exited 0. Among them: `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cli-test-child-env`, `check:published-files`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-closing-keyword-parity` (each with `--self-test` where it is derived). Eight gates first answered exit 3 before the build. They were re-run after the closure build, and five of them went to exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED, exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), all three left to CI: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (packages outside the cli closure have no `dist/`), `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` (example configs outside the closure are not built), and `pnpm check:type-check-debt` (its re-measure build did not get a turn on the shared lock).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: no path-derived mandate. Changed lines: 253 (+239 / -14), under the 3000 threshold.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/issue-35079-skills-staged-swap-reland`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`, run before the push.
- Body gate: `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --body` binds exactly one declaration, this card's, on the line under the header.
</details>

`@objectstack/cli` publishes, so the patch changeset from #35495 comes along unchanged. No `skip-changeset`.
